title: Petcove PurrTek Max Self Cleaning Litter Box
writeup: The Petcove PurrTek Max self-cleaning litter box (model PC-PRRTKMX-GRY), brand new, is $179.99 at Woot. Petcove's own store and Walmart (sold by Petcove Shop) both charge $429.99 for the same unit, so Woot is about $250 cheaper. It's the XL 65L drum version built for up to 3 cats and cats up to 22 lbs, and Woot showed only a small batch at posting.
